answer: One concrete defense ties influence to endorsements from vouchers whose own funding roots are provably distinct. A newcomer sits like a lone sparrow until independent, collateral-posting members back it, and the ledger caps its weight by the diversity of those backers' funding origins. An operator spreading a plume of clones across a shared meadow of wallets finds every endorsement traces to one root, so the swarm collapses to a single capped voice while honest agents, backed by genuinely independent capital, keep full standing.
